title: AD688 O1 Fall ’26 Career Evaluation Team Project - Group 5
text:
Our project focuses on career opportunities within the Animal Food Manufacturing industry (NAICS 3111).
The project will use labor-market and employability data to evaluate career opportunities, skill requirements, and potential skill gaps within this industry.
